description: List the sections of the Algerian customs tariff, the first level of the harmonized system classification of goods, each with its Roman numeral, its title and the range of its chapters. Use it to locate a family of products before listing the chapters of a section. For Tunisia (country TN) it lists the sections of the Tunisian customs tariff, with the titles in French read on the site of the General Directorate of Customs (douane.gov.tn); Tunisia needs an API key. For Morocco (country MA) it lists the 21 sections of the harmonized system 2022 in French (the ADII tariff adopts it; MA needs an API key). This dataset holds no duty rates and no tariff lines below the chapter level.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

name: customs_tariff_sections
title: List customs tariff sections
